title: Kelemvor's Kiss Branch
summary: The thorn Nettie can use to inflict a worsening toxic infection in the Emerald Grove dialogue.

fields.Quest trigger: Nettie poisons the speaking character if they offer their hand after being dishonest during Get Help from Healer Nettie. A successful DC 10 Nature check can identify the branch during the dialogue for non-Druids and non-Rangers. The recovered branch has no verified player attack or coating action.
fields.At Death’s Door: Initially reduces every ability score by 2. Resting worsens the infection, progressing to penalties of 4 and 6.
fields.Treatment: Use an Antidote or another effect that clears the Poisoned status group. On Antidotes by Nettie’s cauldron teaches the recipe: Salts of Mugwort plus any Suspension.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
